Method of Attack: Triangulate location of infected devices through WiFi scanning and Google's geolocation API
Abuse Windows WLAN API to collect WiFi access point data
Send HTTPS POST requests with WiFi data to Google's geolocation API
Send geographic position, encryption method, SSID data to command and control (C2) server
Track breached device almost in real time
Attack Vector: WiFi scanning via Windows WLAN API
Indicators of Compromise: HTTPS POST requests containing WiFi access point information in JSON format to Google's geolocation API
JSON POST requests to C2 server with victim location data
